name: feature_registry_create

ownership.argument: This is where a registry instance comes from on p67: it is created per app host object, not fetched from a global. That is the reason feature_register_feature cannot be called from a native callback without a host-provided registry.

provenance.source: Allocates a 24-byte registry object, initialises its list head at +0 (self-linked), then calls the framework init 0xC86E764(registry, *(host+12)) which registers every built-in feature, and finally binds it to the host through 0xC86700C(registry, host). One caller: the thunk 0xC86236C reached from the AIOTJS/ferry side at 0xC911306.

notes: This is where a registry instance comes from on p67: it is created per app host object, not fetched from a global. That is the reason feature_register_feature cannot be called from a native callback without a host-provided registry.
